core.wg.dailyDesc: A new ayah every day. Tap it to open the page.
core.wg.cannot: Your launcher can’t add it from here. Use the steps below.
core.wg.after: Your phone asks you to confirm and place it. You can also long-press the home screen → Widgets → Ayah Studio.
core.wg.step1: Long-press an empty spot on your home screen.
core.wg.step2: Tap Widgets and find Ayah Studio.
core.wg.step3: Hold a widget and drag it where you want it.
core.wg.hint: Keep your streak on your home screen
core.pr.fail.denied: Ayah Studio isn’t allowed to use your location. Allow it in the phone settings (Apps → Ayah Studio → Location).
core.pr.fail.off: Location is turned off on the phone. Turn it on and try again.
core.pr.fail.timeout: Couldn’t find your location just now. Try again in a moment (Wi‑Fi or mobile data helps).
core.pr.fail.unsupported: This device can’t share its location.

core.rl.signInFirst: Sign in with Google first, so your friend’s relight reaches you

core.welcome.label: Welcome
core.welcome.langText: For the buttons and menus. The Quran is always in Arabic.
core.welcome.reciterText: Tap ▶ to hear a voice, then pick one. You can change it any time.
core.welcome.themeText: The colour of buttons and highlights. The mushaf page stays plain.
core.nudge.help: A short note when you finish a goal, and a reminder in the evening if your flame is not lit yet. Notifications only come while the app is in the background.
